title: German Potato Dumplings
description: A traditional German potato dumpling recipe adapted to be vegan. These dumplings are boiled and served with a side of your favorite sauce.
instructions: Peel the potatoes and grate them.
In a large bowl, combine the grated potatoes, flour, nutritional yeast, garlic powder, and salt.
Gradually add the water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it's smooth.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion to the skillet and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, until they're golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite sauce.
